title: T5 implementation patterns appended to Plan K netns adversarial log
body: Appended "## T5 Improver — Implementation Patterns" (lines 1056-1504) to artifacts/designs/process/ADVERSARIAL-universal-media-decomposer-plan-k-netns-workflow.md after T4 landed. Ten implementation patterns for the surviving workflow-only amendment: (1) job/step decomposition with single-owner compose-start.sh wrapper + mandatory #!/usr/bin/env bash (T4 HIGH shebang trap); (2) daemon preflight snapshot with two failure phases (reachability wait vs capability assertion); (3) four serialized Compose batches preserving full split topology with --profile sandbox pinning and COMPOSE_PARALLEL_LIMIT=1 decision (verified against current Docker docs + docker/compose#10547); (4) exact anchored marker regex + rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]} capture (R18 proved pipefail OFF); (5) one-shot state model with first-exit hard-failure rule (restart: on-failure trap) + 300s bounded docker wait; (6) JWT mint inside wrapper with same-process export (GITHUB_ENV trap); (7) per-batch + final full-set reconcile, classified re-up, 60s/5s settle window proposal; (8) umd-evidence/ artifact schema incl. escalation-verdict.txt; (9) independent sandbox classification + HIGH env-parity fix for sandbox-runner; (10) fail-closed aggregate gate reading escalation verdict + escalation route. Mapped to Plan K P3-S3/S3-S4/S3-S5 + preserved L9/DD C1-C8/Task.md §40 rows. All technology claims re-checked 2026-08-29. R18 handled per T4 correction (corroborated at coordination tier via exec-manager L105/researcher L8; tier-1 GitHub re-retrieval pending). No code/workflow/DD/plan edits (L7).
